text:
harper: Customer reported duplicated side-effects after a 429 burst + key rotation. Two POSTs ~180ms apart.
mina: Did they include Idempotency-Key?
harper: Only on sync path. Their streaming helper never set it.
kai: And traces show immediate retry while refresh was in flight. Classic race.
mina: Short fix: add a tiny refresh guard (150-300ms buffer) before retries + jittered backoff. Also update streaming samples to always attach idempotency header.
dev-bot: Created ticket DX-5510: streaming-idempotency-parity + refresh-guard.
harper: I'll draft the customer note with mitigation steps and link PRs. Mina, can you own the Python sample patch?
mina: Yep. I'll add a dev-mode assert to fail if side-effect POST lacks Idempotency-Key.
kai: Add telemetry metric retry.during_refresh so Console can alert if counts spike.
harper: Thanks all :thumbsup:
